competencies.statement: The learner can build efficient, scalable ETL (extract, transform, load) processes.
competencies.description: Designs an ETL flow that scales and is maintainable.

competencies.statement: The learner can automate data ingestion from multiple sources.
competencies.description: Sets up automated ingestion from varied sources.

competencies.statement: The learner can optimize data workflows for performance and reliability.
competencies.description: Improves throughput/reliability of a pipeline.

competencies.statement: The learner can process and clean raw data to ensure quality and consistency.
competencies.description: Applies cleaning steps that fix quality issues.

competencies.statement: The learner can perform data transformation and feature engineering for analytics.
competencies.description: Transforms/derives features suited to analysis.

competencies.statement: The learner can implement data validation techniques to identify and resolve anomalies.
competencies.description: Adds validation that catches and handles anomalies.

competencies.statement: The learner can manage SQL and NoSQL databases for structured and unstructured data.
competencies.description: Chooses/operates the right store for the data shape.

competencies.statement: The learner can write complex queries for data retrieval and processing.
competencies.description: Writes correct multi-join/aggregate queries.

competencies.statement: The learner can optimize indexing, partitioning, and query execution plans.
competencies.description: Reads a plan and improves query performance.

competencies.statement: The learner can use frameworks such as Apache Spark, Hadoop, or Kafka for big-data processing.
competencies.description: Applies the right big-data framework to a workload.

competencies.statement: The learner can implement distributed computing and parallel-processing techniques.
competencies.description: Parallelizes a job correctly (partitioning/shuffles).

competencies.statement: The learner can develop scalable solutions for handling large data volumes.
competencies.description: Designs for volume without bottlenecks.

competencies.statement: The learner can implement encryption and access-control policies for data.
competencies.description: Applies encryption + least-privilege access correctly.

competencies.statement: The learner can monitor and enforce data-privacy and compliance standards (GDPR, CCPA).
competencies.description: Identifies compliant handling of regulated data.

competencies.statement: The learner can manage data lineage and auditing for traceability.
competencies.description: Tracks lineage so data flow is auditable.

competencies.statement: The learner can analyze and improve query performance in relational and NoSQL databases.
competencies.description: Diagnoses and speeds up a slow query.

competencies.statement: The learner can optimize data storage formats and compression techniques.
competencies.description: Picks formats/compression suited to access patterns.

competencies.statement: The learner can automate performance monitoring and scaling.
competencies.description: Sets up monitoring/autoscaling for a data system.

competencies.statement: The learner can deploy and manage cloud-based data solutions (AWS, GCP, Azure).
competencies.description: Stands up/operates a managed cloud data service.

competencies.statement: The learner can implement serverless and containerized data workflows.
competencies.description: Chooses serverless/containers appropriately.

competencies.statement: The learner can use cloud-native data-warehouse services such as BigQuery, Redshift, or Snowflake.
competencies.description: Uses a cloud warehouse effectively for a workload.

competencies.statement: The learner can develop streaming data pipelines for real-time analytics.
competencies.description: Builds a streaming pipeline with correct semantics.

competencies.statement: The learner can use streaming tools such as Apache Flink, Kafka Streams, or Spark Streaming.
competencies.description: Applies a streaming framework to a real-time need.

competencies.statement: The learner can implement event-driven architectures for data processing.
competencies.description: Designs an event-driven data flow.

competencies.statement: The learner can work effectively with data analysts, scientists, and software engineers.
competencies.description: Collaborates to meet downstream data needs.

competencies.statement: The learner can document data models, pipelines, and system architecture.
competencies.description: Produces clear, accurate data documentation.

competencies.statement: The learner can present findings and improvements to stakeholders.
competencies.description: Communicates data work clearly to stakeholders.
